description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to Land Parcel in Samanpura, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala  District - Cad. Map No. 420213
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to ownership or possession of land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title registration, cadastral mapping, and determination of land ownership rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
